fact_text: The analyst's source put the KSE-100 forward earnings multiple at about 6.75 times on 29 Nov 2024, with major stocks such as OGDC and PPL still near 4 times.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE 100 Index Bull Run: How Far Will It Go? | PSX Analysis, OGDCL, PPL & FABL Insights' (YouTube, 2024-11-29)

fact_text: The KSE-100 constituent market capitalisation was about 45.7 billion USD on 29 Nov 2024.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE 100 Index Bull Run: How Far Will It Go? | PSX Analysis, OGDCL, PPL & FABL Insights' (YouTube, 2024-11-29)

fact_text: The analyst linked the index rally to falling interest rates, with the 12-month T-bill yield falling sharply, and said that trend drives the index's rise.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE 100 Index Bull Run: How Far Will It Go? | PSX Analysis, OGDCL, PPL & FABL Insights' (YouTube, 2024-11-29)

fact_text: The State Bank policy rate was about 15 percent as of 29 Nov 2024, ahead of the monetary policy decision scheduled for 16 Dec 2024.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE 100 Index Bull Run: How Far Will It Go? | PSX Analysis, OGDCL, PPL & FABL Insights' (YouTube, 2024-11-29)

fact_text: The analyst expects the policy rate to fall by at least 1 percentage point at the 16 Dec 2024 monetary policy meeting, and possibly more, based on the 12-month T-bill yield.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE 100 Index Bull Run: How Far Will It Go? | PSX Analysis, OGDCL, PPL & FABL Insights' (YouTube, 2024-11-29)

fact_text: In the mid-2000s the rupee traded near 55 per USD and later near 68 per USD, a much stronger rupee than in 2024, which the analyst used to compare market capitalisation over time.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE 100 Index Bull Run: How Far Will It Go? | PSX Analysis, OGDCL, PPL & FABL Insights' (YouTube, 2024-11-29)

fact_text: The analyst said the index's dollar market capitalisation is still below its mid-2000s level, when the rupee traded at a much lower rate per dollar.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE 100 Index Bull Run: How Far Will It Go? | PSX Analysis, OGDCL, PPL & FABL Insights' (YouTube, 2024-11-29)

fact_text: Some investors compare the KSE-100 rally with Argentina's Merval index, where a current account deficit and high interest rates were similar issues, though the analyst said Pakistan's index is not at the same level in dollar terms.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE 100 Index Bull Run: How Far Will It Go? | PSX Analysis, OGDCL, PPL & FABL Insights' (YouTube, 2024-11-29)

fact_text: The analyst said the 75% depositor-sharing rule should weigh on Meezan's earnings, with an EPS impact of about 2 to 3 PKR per share expected in 2025.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE 100 Index Bull Run: How Far Will It Go? | PSX Analysis, OGDCL, PPL & FABL Insights' (YouTube, 2024-11-29)

fact_text: Faysal Bank's share price fell from about 56 to about 47 PKR after the Islamic-bank regulation news, a drop the analyst said was well priced in.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE 100 Index Bull Run: How Far Will It Go? | PSX Analysis, OGDCL, PPL & FABL Insights' (YouTube, 2024-11-29)

fact_text: The analyst said Faysal Bank trades at a discount to its book value and at a lower price-to-book multiple than most other banks.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE 100 Index Bull Run: How Far Will It Go? | PSX Analysis, OGDCL, PPL & FABL Insights' (YouTube, 2024-11-29)

fact_text: The analyst described his view of Faysal Bank as neutral to positive heading into the December dividend, and said the rule's earnings effect will become clearer in 2025.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'KSE 100 Index Bull Run: How Far Will It Go? | PSX Analysis, OGDCL, PPL & FABL Insights' (YouTube, 2024-11-29)
